purpose: Symptom -> likely cause -> likely responsibility triage. Feeds the NEX safety-and-liability framework. Not legal advice - a starting point for investigation.
disclaimer: Every incident is fact-specific. Actual liability is determined by contract, applicable law, insurance policy terms and evidence. NEX must always recommend qualified legal advice for active claims.

entries.cause: Poor fixing at installation
entries.investigation_hint: Check original installation photos for fixing type and substrate

entries.cause: Wall plug or fixing degraded over time under normal use
entries.investigation_hint: How old is the installation?

entries.cause: Wrong bracket specification for the load
entries.investigation_hint: Check design spec against actual bracket used

entries.cause: Fixed only into plasterboard - never went into structure
entries.investigation_hint: Remove bracket - what was behind it?

entries.cause: Poor original base fixing
entries.investigation_hint: Access base fixing and inspect

entries.cause: Rot at floor line from historic moisture
entries.investigation_hint: Source of moisture must be found and stopped

entries.cause: Wrong species or grade for the load
entries.investigation_hint: Check material specification against project brief

entries.cause: Wedge over-driven - split from below
entries.investigation_hint: Inspect underside for wedge damage

entries.cause: Impact damage from dropped or dragged object
entries.investigation_hint: Ask when the damage appeared

entries.cause: Timber shrinkage in wide solid riser (hairline)
entries.investigation_hint: Is the crack fine (< 1mm) and following the grain?

entries.cause: Poor wedging at manufacture
entries.investigation_hint: Full-flight pattern or only new stairs suggests manufacture

entries.cause: Poor installation packing between staircase and structure
entries.investigation_hint: Squeak on install day or shortly after

entries.cause: Seasonal timber movement from heating cycles
entries.investigation_hint: Squeaks only in winter, disappears in summer

entries.symptom: Squeaking stairs after 2-3 months on new install
entries.cause: Timber acclimatising to house environment
entries.investigation_hint: Small adjustment period is normal but stairs should not squeak long-term

entries.cause: Design or manufacture error
entries.investigation_hint: Check design drawings against as-built spacing

entries.cause: Missing spindle that has fallen out
entries.investigation_hint: How old, was spindle previously in place?

entries.cause: Original build predates current regulations
entries.responsibility: grandfathered - not fault under most codes
entries.investigation_hint: Age of the building

entries.cause: Manufacture or install error
entries.investigation_hint: Which risers vary and by how much?

entries.cause: Floor covering added after install changed effective rise of first or last step
entries.investigation_hint: When was flooring added?

entries.cause: Original design did not meet Doc K minimum (2000mm UK domestic)
entries.investigation_hint: Measure headroom against pitch line

entries.cause: Loft conversion or extension has reduced ceiling above stair after original install
entries.investigation_hint: When was the ceiling changed?

entries.cause: Undersized stringer for the span
entries.investigation_hint: Structural engineer assessment

entries.cause: Rot from long-term moisture ignored
entries.investigation_hint: Was there visible water damage or staining ignored?

entries.symptom: Floating staircase cantilever bracket pulling out of wall
entries.cause: Wall structure inadequate for cantilever load
entries.responsibility: designer_or_engineer (wall spec) or installer (if fixings wrong)
entries.investigation_hint: Structural engineer assessment mandatory

entries.symptom: Floating staircase cantilever bracket pulling out of wall
entries.cause: Fixings undersized for design load
entries.investigation_hint: Check original spec against installed fixings

entries.cause: Impact damage during furniture move or use
entries.investigation_hint: When did the chip appear?

entries.cause: Manufacturing defect propagating under load
entries.investigation_hint: Check age - defect propagating early points to manufacture

entries.cause: Contamination on tread (water, polish, wax)
entries.investigation_hint: What was on the tread at time of slip?

entries.cause: Original finish specified without adequate slip resistance
entries.investigation_hint: What finish was specified? High-gloss lacquer without slip additive?

entries.cause: Worn tread nosing reducing traction
entries.responsibility: property_owner (maintenance) or original spec if unusually rapid wear
entries.investigation_hint: How old is the installation? Normal wear or premature?

entries.cause: Poor original surface preparation before painting
entries.investigation_hint: Recent install or long-standing

entries.cause: Wrong paint type over unsuitable substrate (water-based over old oil-based without primer)
entries.investigation_hint: Paint substrate check

entries.symptom: Visible glue squeeze-out on finished timber
entries.cause: Installer did not clean glue before finish coat
entries.investigation_hint: Where was the finish applied - workshop or site?

entries.cause: Solid tread finished on top face only, unsealed underside creating moisture imbalance
entries.investigation_hint: Check underside for finish

entries.cause: Wide solid board reaching movement limits in seasonal humidity swing
entries.responsibility: manufacturer (material selection) or normal timber behaviour
entries.investigation_hint: How wide is the board?

entries.cause: Installer did not provide required documentation
entries.investigation_hint: This is an evidence gap - complicates all other liability assessment

usage: 2. NEX filters entries[] by symptom match.
3. For each matching entry, NEX walks the user through the investigation_hint to distinguish causes.
4. Once cause is narrowed, responsibility is triage-only - a starting point for investigation, not a final determination.
5. NEX always closes with: 'This is not legal advice. If a formal claim is involved, contact your insurer and a solicitor.'
6. Cross-link diag_ref to data/staircase-diagnosis-engine.json for the diagnostic and repair detail.
not_in_v1: Regional legal-code variance (Consumer Rights Act, product liability directives)
Cost apportionment where multiple parties share responsibility
